name: Australia
registration_steps: Enrol at aec.gov.au (compulsory for all eligible Australians aged 18+)
Click 'Enrol to vote' and provide your full name, date of birth, address
Deadline: 7pm local time on the day the writs are issued (usually 1-2 days after election announced)
Update your enrolment if you move to a new address
voting_steps: You will receive a poll card showing your polling place
Attend your polling place on election day (or vote early at any AEC office)
No photo ID required — your name is checked against the roll
Give your full name and address to polling officials
For the House of Representatives: Number ALL boxes from 1 to the total number of candidates
For the Senate: Number at least 6 boxes above the line OR at least 12 boxes below the line
Fold and place your completed ballot(s) in the appropriate ballot box
notes: VOTING IS COMPULSORY in Australia. Failure to vote without a valid reason may result in a fine. Postal and pre-poll voting options are available. Australian citizens overseas must also enrol and vote.
